name: SG Eco Fund

funder.name: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, Singapore

summary: Co-funding for community-engaging environmental projects in Singapore, from small Sprout grants to large Main grants. Nature and biodiversity is one of several eligible areas alongside climate, energy and waste.

amount.note: Sprout category capped at S$30,000, Main category at S$1 million; up to 80% of supportable costs

calls.label: Sprout and Main application periods
calls.recurring: Sprout: 1 Jan to 30 Apr, 1 May to 31 Aug, 1 Sep to 31 Dec. Main: 1 May to 31 Aug. Every year, no year stated on the page.

status.quote: All application forms must be successfully submitted by 23:59 of the respective deadline.

recurring.quote: Sprout 1 January to 30 April 30 April July 1 August 1 May to 31 August 31 August November 1 December 1 September to 31 December 31 December March (following year) 1 April (following year) Main 1 May to 31 August 31 August March (following year) 1 April (following year)

applicant_types.quote: Team of Individuals: All individuals must be 18 years old and above, and residing in Singapore; the group must have at least one Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident; Organisations: Singapore-registered organisations, including companies, charities, government and non-government organisations

geography.quote: Improve the environment or advance environmental sustainability in Singapore

window.quote: SG Eco Fund application timelines for each category

amount.quote: capped at a grant amount of $30,000 for the Sprout category or $1 million for the Main category

co_finance_required.quote: The SG Eco Fund works on a co-funding basis.
